data.current_description:
Retrieve all attachments.

These attachments are already synced, so this endpoint never calls the ATS and the files sit in the destination you configured.

The on-demand alternatives call the ATS and return a `data_url` we host: [get candidate attachments](/ats/v1/get-candidates-candidate-id-attachments) for every file of one candidate, [get application attachments](/ats/v1/get-applications-application-id-attachments) for the files of one application.

data.description_suggestion: Retrieve all pre-synced attachments from the ATS system. These attachments are already cached and stored in your configured destination, so this endpoint does not call the ATS directly. Returns a paginated list of attachment objects with file metadata and storage locations. For on-demand file retrieval with hosted data URLs, use the candidate-specific or application-specific attachment endpoints instead.
